description: If an authorized x402 payment was reserved but the network response containing its receipt UUID was lost, compute SHA-256 of the exact original Payment-Signature header locally and supply ONLY the 64-character hexadecimal fingerprint. This free lookup never accepts the raw signature, creates a charge, executes a paid API or contacts a payment facilitator. The fingerprint itself is private bearer material.

payment_signature_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex of the exact original raw Payment-Signature header. NEVER put the signed payment header itself in this field.

name: kevaremesh_locate_owned_receipt
title: Recover a missing paid order receipt ID from your own payment signature fingerprint
